'''Rikdine''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] who fought in the [[Battle of Corellia]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. He served as a liaison between the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] forces on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], coordinating the arrival of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] reinforcements for the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] known as the [[Hero of Tython]]&mdash;the new [[Supreme Commander (Jedi)|Supreme Commander]] of Jedi forces on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Until reinforcements arrive, rally those few Jedi already on the surface. My contact, Captain Rikdine, will help you locate them.|Master Satele Shan, to the Hero|<ref name="Jedi Commander" />}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]],<ref name="Jedipedia" /> Rikdine had achieved the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]]<ref name="Jedi Commander" /> by the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3640 BBY]].<ref name="Time">{{TOR_dates|4}}</ref> As the [[Galactic War]] erupted between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], Rikdine was among those sent to the Imperial-occupied [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] to [[Battle of Corellia|drive]] the Empire off the prestigious [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]]. Rikdine was deployed in the [[Blastfield Shipyards]] region on the edges of Corellia's [[Capital/Legends|capital]], [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]], and during the battle he served as the personal military contact of [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Satele Shan]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. Many [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Death/Legends|fell]] in the early stages of the battle, but Rikdine ensured that the bodies of the fallen were returned to the Order's [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]], where they could be buried. As the battle progressed, Shan contacted Rikdine and informed him of the impending arrival of the Jedi reinforcements that Shan had drawn from the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] as well as several other worlds.<ref name="Jedi Commander" />

[[File:Socorro_Freight_Building.png|thumb|left|230px|The Socorro Freight building where Rikdine was based]]
From his post at the [[Socorro Freight building]] in the Blastfield [[Shipyard/Legends|Shipyards]], which was being used as a makeshift Jedi command center, Rikdine organized and coordinated the arrival of the Jedi [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttles]] and ensured that they reached secure landing zones safely. When the [[Hero of Tython]]&mdash;a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] who had been appointed the [[Supreme Commander (Jedi)|Jedi Supreme Commander]] by the Grand Master&mdash;arrived at the building, Rikdine was relieved to see that the Knight had made it safely and gave the Jedi all of the information he had on the few Jedi who were known to still be alive on Corellia. While the Hero sought out those Jedi and ordered them to meet up at the Socorro Freight building, Rikdine coordinated the last [[Transport/Legends|transports]] from the planets [[Orto/Legends|Orto]], [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]], [[Kinyen/Legends|Kinyen]], and [[Duro/Legends|Duro]], and when the Knight returned to Rikdine, the captain relayed [[General/Legends|General]] [[Var Suthra]]'s request for a holocall and patched the Knight through to the general in the [[Labor Valley]] district. At Suthra's request, the Outer Rim Jedi relocated to the Labor Valley, and Rikdine oversaw their transfer to the area.<ref name="Jedi Commander" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|My job is to organize your forces.|Captain Rikdine, to the Hero|<ref name="Jedi Commander" />}}
A fair-skinned man, Rikdine had [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and green [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], though he was largely bald by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the Battle of Corellia. He was a competent commander and coordinator, and he was saddened that many Jedi died in the battle on Corellia but tried his best to ensure that the bodies of the fallen were treated with dignity and returned home.<ref name="Jedi Commander" />

==Equipment==
Rikdine wore a gray Republic Military [[Republic military uniforms/Legends|uniform]].<ref name="Jedi Commander" />

==Behind the scenes==
Rikdine first appeared in the Jedi Knight-class mission "Jedi Commander" in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]] in [[2011]]. Rikdine, like characters in the other three Republic-class storylines on Corellia, also tasks the player with speaking with [[Corporal/Legends|Corporal]] [[Hartke]], the starting character for the Republic world arc in the Blastfield Shipyards.<ref name="Jedi Commander" /> Players must complete the world arc mission "Blockade Runner" before their own class storyline can proceed to the Labor Valley, and if the player has completed Hartke's mission beforehand, Rikdine will not mention the mission. As it is unknown who [[canon]]ically completed "Blockade Runner," this article refrains from including information on that mission.<ref name="Blockade Runner">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|Blockade Runner|Corellia}}</ref>
